text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, Cheval-san hasn't moved an inch since casting her line... It's already been 2 hours though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (An environment where Cheval-san can relax... I thought finding that out would soften the mood during discussions, but...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Diaaa! Whatcha doing hiding over there? Wearing sunglasses and all~, are you tailing someone?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Tailing... wait, the only one in sight is Cheval... don't tell me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-san, Verxina-san...! Perfect timing, may I ask for your advice?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's why you're watching Cheval... But honestly, if you're asking whether even we can converse smoothly with her... well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: She tends to stop right when she's about to say something, right? I always poke her cheeks telling her to just spit it out though~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I apologize for prying. What do the two of you do when that happens?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: At times like that, either wait patiently... or else, you know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina & Vivlos
text_block_list.text: We go to the sea!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: When Cheval is in a place she loves, conversations flow naturally... well, maybe not completely, but her tension softens up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: In other words, relaaaxation! It's totally, completely worth a shot~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see...! Thank you so much for the valuable advice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a walk by the sea,
I happened to come across Satono Diamond and the others.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Woow, the sea~! Wait, wasn't this get-together supposed to be a charity meeting?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I thought we could brainstorm ideas while taking in the sights! Let's take it easy and have fun with it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...While... having fun...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, beach flags took everything out of me... wait!
You're eating ice cream! Hey, save some for me!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Eating ice cream while watching the ocean is the absolute best~!
Man, what a great location!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I... should get some too...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look! What cute seashells!
And there are so many of them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're right...!
Couldn't we pick these up and use them for our merch?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome! Hey, how about making the booth look like a beach hut?
Like, having a "sea" theme or something!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's wonderful...!
I'd love to make the sweets we sell fit the theme too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Cheval-san!
What were you going to say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Anything is fine.
...Please, let us know what you think.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um, well.
...Maybe shaved ice... would fit the vibe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The carrot cake mentioned earlier... also sounded delicious, but...
...Actually, I was a bit worried about the cost of wheat flour...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When I baked a cake with my sisters before...
the ingredients ended up costing quite a lot...
I-It was tasty, though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see...! By switching from flour to ice, we keep the costs down, increase profits, and can donate even more!
Thank you, Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Was an opinion like that... really helpful?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please keep them coming! By taking advantage of the different perspectives everyone here brings...
let's make this a wonderful shop together!
